title: Convex ridge potential (spec)
claim: A strongly convex potential has exactly one stationary point, and it is the global minimum.
residual: x0 - alpha*x - (sigmoid(x @ Wr.T + b) * s) @ Wr
notes: Mirrors the hand-written `convex` domain. Kept as the reference example for the spec format, and as a regression test that a declared domain reproduces a coded one.
